entries.source: A beautiful woman, clad in shining plate armour. Power radiates from her.
entries.target: 一位身披板甲的美女。力量从她身上散发出来。

entries.source: You must wear this object to use it!
entries.target: 你必须装备这件物品才能使用它！

entries.source: #ROYAL_BLUE#The golem decides to change it's name to #{bold}#%s#{normal}#.
Cripple the target reducing mind, spell, and combat action speeds by 30%
entries.target: 致残目标，降低30%攻击、施法和精神速度

entries.source: A vial of greater demon bile. It hurts your sinuses even with the vial's stopper firmly in place.
entries.target: 一瓶大恶魔的胆汁。尽管有着良好的阻隔，它仍刺激着你的鼻窦。

entries.source: A Halfling, with a sling. Beware.
entries.target: 一位携带投石索的半身人。当心。

entries.source: You need to ready alchemist gems in your quiver.
Their use of magic is innate and not really studied; as such they do not naturally regenerate mana and must use external means of recharging.
entries.target: 他们的魔法并非习得而是与生俱来的，因此他们不能依靠自然的法力恢复而必须依靠额外的方法来恢复法力值。
你已经是西弗格罗斯了！

entries.source: You are yanked out of this place!
entries.target: 你“呼”的一下被带离了这个地方！

entries.source: Small and bloodshot. Its dead gaze still burns your skin.
entries.target: 小而充血。它死去后的凝视仍灼痛着你的皮肤。

entries.source: You must be able to move to use this talent.
entries.target: 你必须处于可以移动的状态才能使用该技能。

entries.source:
Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.
He looks hurt.
entries.target: 绿皮丑陋的生物，这只笨重的人形生物在盯着你并握紧了满是肉瘤的绿色拳头。他看起来受伤了。
暴击时 火焰溅射伤害
